# Pravine Mani

> Toronto consultancy across AI workflows, programmatic SEO + GEO, and marketing automation. Built like an operator. Sold by the project. Founder of AIOpsForge.

## Overview

Pravine Mani runs a one-person consultancy in Toronto, Canada, focused on four areas: AI workflows (Claude Code, MCP, agent systems), programmatic SEO + GEO (Schema.org, llms.txt, passage-level citability), marketing automation (lead pipelines, lifecycle email, CRM wiring), and Agentic OS (multi-agent orchestration systems, sub-agent design, concurrent-agent evals). McMaster Computer Engineering & Management graduate (2025). Background includes 5G software engineering at Ericsson (Go, gRPC), full-stack development at Imprimo (React Native, Postgres), and mobile development at Fixvi (React Native, push infra).

## Focus Areas

- [AI workflows](https://pravinemani.com/services/ai/): Custom workflows, MCP servers, agent systems, prompt + eval suites. Code-first on Claude Code + Vercel.
- [SEO + GEO](https://pravinemani.com/services/seo/): Programmatic SEO at scale, Schema.org structured data, AI-search visibility (llms.txt + passage citability), local SEO.
- [Marketing automation](https://pravinemani.com/services/marketing-automation/): Lead pipelines, lifecycle email, CRM + webhook wiring, Stripe subscriptions. Vercel + Resend + Supabase.
- [Agentic OS](https://pravinemani.com/services/agentic-os/): Multi-agent orchestration systems, sub-agent design, concurrent-agent evals. R&D stage — open for first-mover engagements.

## Engagement Shapes

- [Workflow Probe](https://pravinemani.com/services/#probe): 90-minute Loom walkthrough + one-page written recommendation. Low three-figures starting. Cheapest on-ramp.
- [System Audit](https://pravinemani.com/services/#audit): A fixed-scope week mapping the business and identifying high-impact opportunities across any focus area. Mid four-figures starting.
- [Build Sprint](https://pravinemani.com/services/#sprint): A productized, fixed-scope build of a single workflow. Mid four-figures starting.
- [Custom Build](https://pravinemani.com/services/#custom): Multi-workflow builds — content engines, MCP servers, full marketing sites with SEO + admin portals. Low five-figures starting.

## Case Studies

- [CISNET — Marketing site + SEO + admin portal rebuild](https://pravinemani.com/work/case-studies/cisnet/): Migrated a Toronto IT certification training company off legacy PHP onto Next.js 16. Delivered 200+ programmatic SEO pages, 70+ individually-mapped redirects, 7 Schema.org JSON-LD types, a full lead pipeline (Facebook Lead Ads → HMAC webhook → Supabase → admin portal → Resend), Stripe Checkout, and a custom admin portal for leads, enrollments, content, and payments. Three months, solo, zero scope creep.

## Stack

- [Stack page](https://pravinemani.com/stack/): Daily-driver tools. Code: Claude Code, Vercel, TypeScript, Next.js 16, Tailwind. AI: Anthropic API, MCP, Claude 4.7. Data: Supabase, Vercel KV, Stripe, Resend. Content/growth: Beehiiv, Plausible, Whop.

## Writing

- [Writing](https://pravinemani.com/writing/): Long-form essays on AI ops, MCP, agent design, code-first vs no-code, and indie operator economics. Currently drafting: "CPR: A Shared Memory Layer for Claude Code and Codex."

## Open Source

- [personalClaudeSkills](https://github.com/pravinemani5545/personalClaudeSkills): Public Claude Code skill library. Slash commands `/growth-sprint`, `/design-system`, `/artifact`, plus EliaAlberti's `/compress`, `/preserve`, `/resume` bundle. Installable via curl into `~/.claude/skills/`.
- [AIOpsForge](https://aiopsforge.dev): $9.99/month community for solo AI builders.
